subject.title: [Feature]: Telegram Business Bot support (business_message / business_connection updates)

question: Should bundled Telegram support include Telegram Business personal-DM handling now, and what account-scoped business_connection_id authority model should it use?
rationale: The feature fits major-channel support, but it expands OpenClaw into Business-connected personal DMs and outbound API mutation after a same-repo implementation was closed for security and routing blockers.

options.title: Approve bounded bundled support
options.body: Implement it in the bundled Telegram plugin with per-account durable Business connection state, disconnect cleanup, Business-aware dedupe/sequencing, docs, tests, and live Telegram proof.

options.title: Require owner design first
options.body: Keep the tracker open but require a short maintainer design note for access control, persistence, and outbound authority before accepting another implementation PR.

options.title: Defer bundled support
options.body: Leave users on external relay/proxy approaches until maintainers explicitly approve a core plugin security model or a new plugin API seam.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded bundled support
recommendation.body: Implement it in the bundled Telegram plugin with per-account durable Business connection state, disconnect cleanup, Business-aware dedupe/sequencing, docs, tests, and live Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc was assigned to and closed the prior same-repo implementation with the clearest current Telegram-owner direction signal.
